_comment: Reference values the Go implementation must reproduce, measured 2026-07-29 from the merged point set preserved as data/bus_27jul_points.json. Amended 2026-08-02: display-rounded values replaced with full precision, worstMinutes corrected, params reduced to the two the pipeline exercises. Pipeline semantics and amendment evidence: journey-27jul2026.CONTRACT.md.

params._provenance: gapThresholdMinutes: read from the archived design spec (roadbook-archive docs/SPEC.md, stage 3). thinSpacingSeconds: RECOVERED BY FIT, not observed — the keep-earliest walk over trace+rawSignals reproduces all 121 timestamps of data/bus_27jul_points.json exactly for spacing in (29, 30] seconds and for no other value; the script that produced this file was not found. joinSlackSeconds (was 120) removed: per SPEC.md stage 2 it padded activity windows during trace attachment, and both 120 s margins around this journey's window contain zero points, so it is unexercised here. minGeometryPoints (was 4) removed: per SPEC.md it tiered whole journeys (ENDPOINTS_ONLY below 4 points), never legs — the merged set contains a 3-point observed run that still counts among the 7 observed legs.

window._note: Exact activity-boundary times from the fixture (start of the first IN_BUS activity, end of the second). The previous minute-truncated values (19:46, 07:12) could not reconstruct the point selection.

distanceKm._note: Chord sums are spherical haversine with R = 6371.0 km exactly (CONTRACT.md §6; other radii fail the 2026-07-29 one-decimal values). googleActivitySum is the sum of distanceMeters over the three activities intersecting the window: 657105.16796875 m.

gaps._note: Replaces worstMinutes [36,36,36,29,28,28], which was the top six of the SEVEN trace-only gaps, not a measurement of the merged set this file pins — CONTRACT.md §9.

stopDetection._note: Bounds are the exact inter-bus-activity dwell from the fixture (previously minute-truncated). displacementKm is first-to-last straight-line displacement of the merged points inside the halt — not the path sum (0.7337); the former movementKm 0.2 was the displacement, rounded.

knownSourceDefect.what: Google activity leg 2 claims start 16.6792036,46.5243547 at 21:57, but the trace places that coordinate at 22:17. At 21:57 the device was ~15 km back at 16.7938,46.6411.
knownSourceDefect.check: activity start/end coordinate vs trace position at stated start/end time
knownSourceDefect._note: Coordinates restated in the fixture's anonymised longitude frame, matching journey-27jul2026.anon.json; the previous text carried source-frame longitudes.

rawSignalsVerdict.conclusion: adds 52 points to the 69-point trace and covers the stationary rest halt, but fills none of the six moving gaps; 1/121 fixes are true GPS
rawSignalsVerdict._note: Counts taken under the full-precision window; the former 120 / WIFI 62 were counts under the minute-truncated window.
